BREACH COSTS ARE ON THE RISE
50% of small orgs could not survive a successful attack
Organizations are facing more — and more costly — data breaches year after year, with average costs in the millions. For mid-sized organizations with limited budgets and resources, a full-scale data breach could be devastating.
PLATFORM
Cloud-native technology  backed by expert human defenders
Our consumer-class user portal provides a unified experience for detecting threats and disrupting malicious actors. The Pondurance Platform ingests & correlates telemetry from all sources for accurate and rapid threat detection. Our always-on SOC provides expert analysis and remediation of valid alerts. And our continuous exposure and vulnerability management gives 360 degree visibility and protection across your attack surface.

Access top cybersecurity talent
Our 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) integrates directly with your IT and security team. You get access to in-demand cybersecurity experts and threat intelligence when you need them most, without the challenges of recruiting and retaining top tech talent.
Integrate with existing tech
No need to rip out your existing security investments. The Pondurance Platform integrates with your existing EDR, firewall and other security technologies you may already have in place. The result is no security gaps and no overlapping capabilities.
Priced for the mid-market
Our MDR cybersecurity service comes complete with an integrated SIEM, world-class threat intelligence, continuous exposure/vulnerability management, and our always-on SOC. So you don’t pay separately for each tool that you need. Pricing is tailored for the needs of mid-market organizations.

WHY PONDURANCE
Empowering the mid-market with cybersecurity that fits
Mitigating breach risks is getting harder every year — and mid-market organizations that handle PII and PHI particularly struggle with the strain this risk puts on resources and IT. We’re here for you. Pondurance acts as an extension of your team to provide the technology, processes, and expertise needed to eliminate breach risks.
